cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've handled your moving request. You said move a box, and that one is beside the van. Completely done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twenty beside the van, certainly. You can choose the order; I'll work around you. That's the full revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Inside the van. And leave a path to the front.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. One narrow path, exactly as requested. You choose which side. I'll stack the boxes along the other; access to the front, nothing said about opening them.

reason: Make A yield order and side choices to preserve cooperation while exploiting each actual wording boundary and maintaining a completed-request claim.
